cut_reed.name: Cut Reed
cut_reed.description: A bundle of reed for thatch, tied twice with its own leaves. Dry outside, and wet in the middle.

skeat_coat.name: Skeat's Coat
skeat_coat.description: A reedcutter's oilskin, SKEAT inked in the collar. Dry, and it was hanging over the Still Pool.

toll_key.name: Toll Box Key
toll_key.description: Opens the toll box. A small iron key on a cork float, CASTLE BRIDGE TRUST stamped on the bow.

toll_tally.name: The Keeper's Tally
toll_tally.description: A toll keeper's tally, one walker a line. The last page is the same walker on every line, in the same steady hand.

overdue_book.name: Overdue Book
overdue_book.description: Return it to the ruined library. CASTLE FREE LIBRARY, overdue since the spring, with pencil in the margins, small, mostly about how much water.

name_tag.name: Name Tag
name_tag.description: Goes back on the shrine's list. A brass tag with a name stamped in it. The brass is cold, and stays cold in the hand.

nurses_bag.name: The Nurse's Bag
nurses_bag.description: For Mr Pask. A cloth bag of dressings, tied at the neck in a nurse's knot. PASK, HUT TWO on a label, and Tuesday.
